about: A machine of your own: its cmux server session, and one agent turn on it through its acpmux. Every step runs through {on}: `sh -c` on the machine itself, `ssh HOST` from another. Set on and cmux, the machine's cmux-tui (its `server` scope; the `cmux` front end calls the same scope `daemon`). No pause or resume. The turn runs on the machine (`--machine local`): acpmux refuses a remote chain into a machine whose sandbox canary shows no sandbox.

agent_turn.run: {on} 'acpmux run --machine local -m claude/haiku --ephemeral --on-permission fail --timeout 150 "Reply with exactly the word PONG and nothing else."'
